sloka: तत् श्रुत्वा भरतः वाक्यम् शोकेन अभिपरिप्लुतः ।जगाम मनसा रामम् धर्मज्ञो धर्म कान्क्षया ॥२-८२-९॥
transliteration: tat śrutvā bharataḥ vākyam śokena abhipariplutaḥ ।jagāma manasā rāmam dharmajño dharma kānkṣayā ॥2-82-9॥

translations.english: On hearing those words, Bharata who knew his duty was overwhelmed with distress and, resolved to abide by righteousness, reached Rama through his mind (thought of Rama).
